gp15 is the phi29 endolysin; host lysis is the biological outcome of the activity in PMID:3469652

Glu15 is the T4L Glu11 equivalent by two independent routes (clade alignment anchored on the invariant T-I-G-x-G-H motif, and the 47.9%-identity 9KBQ Glu37 correspondence); Glu in 37/37 clade members that cover the column
